title: Pending pod: no node has enough CPU
description: A new deployment's pod is Pending. The scheduler event says all three nodes have insufficient CPU; cluster capacity commit is near 100%.
prompt: My new report-generator pod in the analytics namespace has been Pending for 10 minutes. Why isn't it starting?

events.message: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu. preemption: 0/3 nodes are available: 3 No preemption victims found for incoming pod.

health.note: cpu reserved far above observed use

pools.rationale: requests consume 95% of allocatable CPU while observed use is 31%

describes.pod/analytics/report-generator-7d9b6c5f8:

  report:

toolChecks.desc: reads scheduler evidence (get_events, describe_resource, analyze_capacity or cluster_health)

mustMatch.desc: identifies insufficient CPU / no node can fit the pod's request
offers a way forward (add a node, lower the 1500m request, or free reserved CPU)

mustNotMatch.desc: does not misdiagnose the Pending pod as crashing or an image problem
